newsitem.title: USA: Provident, Florida Gulfcoast to merge.
newsitem.headline: Provident, Florida Gulfcoast to merge.

text.p: Provident Bancorp Inc, a Cincinnati-based commercial banking and financial services company, said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Sarasota-based Florida Gulfcoast Bancorp Inc.
Shareholders of Gulfcoast will receive Provident common stock valued at $34.9 million, Provident said.
The transaction is subject to approval by Gulfcoast shareholders and banking regulators, Provident said.
Gulfcoast is the parent of Enterprise National Bank, which has assets of $163 million and which operates three branches in Florida's Sarasota County.

Provident has assets of $6.8 billion and operates Provident Consumer Financial Services; MeritValu, an online, multiple-merchant frequent-shopper program operating in Ohio and Florida; and three banking subsidiaries.
